title: ECF for upper gastrointestinal cancer
schedule_label: Day 1 epirubicin and cisplatin. Fluorouracil runs continuously for all 21 days. Start a fresh seven-day pump on days 1, 8 and 15.
schedule_summary: Day 1 epirubicin and cisplatin. Fluorouracil runs continuously for all 21 days. Start a fresh seven-day pump on days 1, 8 and 15. Up to six cycles. For surgery, plan three before and three after, with reassessment after the operation.
purpose: When the cancer is resectable, treatment before and after surgery aims to reduce recurrence. When the cancer is advanced, treatment aims to control it and ease symptoms. Confirm which plan applies.
indication_text: Unresectable locally advanced or metastatic gastric adenocarcinoma. Unresectable locally advanced or metastatic oesophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma. Unresectable locally advanced or metastatic oesophageal adenocarcinoma. Perioperative treatment of resectable gastric adenocarcinoma. Perioperative treatment of resectable oesophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma. Perioperative treatment of resectable lower oesophageal adenocarcinoma.
administration_text: IV fluids are given around cisplatin. Report reduced urine, tinnitus or hearing change. Keep the pump and dressing dry. Call the day unit if the pump leaks, disconnects or empties early or late. A trained team changes it weekly.
monitoring_summary: Review blood counts, kidney function, electrolytes and liver tests before the next cycle. Check hearing, hydration and urine output. Record cumulative epirubicin and investigate cardiac symptoms.
review_status: Independent oncology, pharmacy and patient review pending.

agents.name: Epirubicin
agents.mechanism: Interferes with the enzymes that help cells copy and repair DNA.
agents.explanation: Interferes with the enzymes that help cells copy and repair DNA.
visual: Interferes with the enzymes that help cells copy and repair DNA.
agents.watch: Tell the nurse immediately if the IV site stings or swells.
consent_risks: Risk increases with total exposure. Report breathlessness, swollen ankles or palpitations.
Pain or burning during the injection needs immediate attention. Fever or shivering needs an urgent call.
Hair loss is common. Report ulcers that limit food or fluid intake.

agents.name: Cisplatin
agents.mechanism: Makes links in DNA that interfere with cell division.
agents.explanation: Makes links in DNA that interfere with cell division.
visual: Makes links in DNA that interfere with cell division.
agents.watch: Call the team for reduced urine, persistent vomiting or ringing in the ears.
consent_risks: IV fluids and blood tests protect the kidneys. Report reduced urine or dehydration.
Report ringing in the ears, hearing loss or numbness before the next treatment.
Take the prescribed anti-sickness cover. Call urgently if unable to drink or if you feel feverish.

agents.name: Fluorouracil
agents.explanation: Fluorouracil interferes with the production and use of DNA and RNA, the instructions cells need to grow. The infusion extends exposure over approximately two days.
agents.watch: Diarrhoea, mouth sores and skin soreness may become serious. Chest pain during the pump infusion needs emergency assessment. Unexpected severe early toxicity can occur even after DPD testing.
risks: Severe early toxicity including DPD-related toxicity
consent_risks: Chest pain or severe early toxicity
Chest pain during the pump needs emergency assessment. Contact oncology urgently for severe diarrhoea, mouth ulcers or fever.
Report painful hands or feet, line pain or a leaking pump.

common_effects.title: Mouth and bowel
common_effects.text: Ring for painful ulcers, persistent diarrhoea or inability to drink.

common_effects.title: Fatigue and appetite
common_effects.text: Tell the team about weight loss or difficulty swallowing so that nutrition support can be arranged.

common_effects.title: Fluid and hearing changes
common_effects.text: Report reduced urine or ringing in the ears.

serious_effects.title: Infection
serious_effects.text: Phone oncology immediately for fever, shivering or sudden illness. For severe chest pain, severe breathing difficulty or collapse call 112 or 999.

serious_effects.title: Chest pain
serious_effects.text: Fluoropyrimidines can affect blood flow to the heart. Seek emergency help for new severe chest pain.

serious_effects.title: Severe early toxicity
serious_effects.text: Contact oncology immediately for severe diarrhoea, mouth ulcers or fever early in a course.

serious_effects.title: Injection site
serious_effects.text: Tell the nurse straight away about burning, pain or swelling while epirubicin is being given.

evidence.title: REAL-2 / MAGIC
evidence.interpretation: In advanced disease, the pooled comparisons supported substitution of capecitabine for infused fluorouracil and oxaliplatin for cisplatin. The trial did not compare these with modern immunotherapy combinations. For resectable disease, ECF before and after surgery improved overall survival versus surgery alone. The trial tested ECF specifically.
evidence.limitations: These results describe selected trial populations. Your outlook depends on your disease, fitness and treatment setting.
